class.name: LightProbeVolumeData
class.brief_description: Stores independently editable light probe positions and stable local IDs.
class.description: Placement data for a [LightProbeVolume]. Positions and IDs are saved together, and the ID allocator never moves backwards during editing or Undo/Redo. This resource stores placement only; it does not contain baked lighting or an interpolation structure.

method.name: get_layout
method.description: Returns a snapshot containing [code]positions[/code] (PackedVector3Array), [code]ids[/code] (PackedInt32Array), [code]next_id[/code] (int), and [code]grid_origins[/code] (Dictionary mapping generated IDs to original grid positions). Modifying the returned dictionary does not change this resource.

method.name: set_layout
method.description: Replaces positions and IDs atomically after validating the snapshot. IDs must be unique, nonnegative, and less than next_id. Positions must be finite. The optional [code]grid_origins[/code] dictionary records grid provenance and is validated before applying the snapshot. Entries for removed IDs are dropped. Snapshots without provenance treat their points as custom. The ID allocator retains the greater of its current value and the supplied next_id.

method.name: get_probe_ids
method.description: Returns stable IDs parallel to the positions array. IDs are unique within this resource, not across different volumes.

method.name: get_probe_count
method.description: Returns the number of probe positions.

method.name: find_probe
method.description: Returns the array index for a stable probe ID, or -1 if it no longer exists.

method.name: get_probe_position
method.description: Returns a probe position by its stable ID.

method.name: set_probe_position
method.description: Moves one probe without changing its ID or other probe positions.

method.name: add_probe
method.description: Adds a probe and returns its new ID, or -1 on failure.

method.name: remove_probe
method.description: Removes a probe without renumbering the remaining IDs.

method.name: get_revision
method.description: Returns a monotonically increasing placement revision for this resource instance. It changes for edits and Undo/Redo; it is not a persistent bake identifier.

method.name: is_custom_probe
method.description: Returns whether an existing probe was added manually or moved from its recorded grid position. Missing IDs return false.

method.name: has_custom_probes
method.description: Returns whether any probe was added manually or moved from its original grid position.

constants.constant: Maximum number of positions in one volume data resource.
